title: Chicken Enchiladas (Cream Cheese Wrapped)
ingredients: Flour tortillas (used instead of traditional corn tortillas)
instructions: Video only — exact steps not transcribed. Filling is wrapped in a cream cheese layer, then rolled in a flour tortilla, appears to be baked/assembled in a large bowl/pan before cooking.
notes: Partial — video only. This is Valerie Rogers' 'authentic' chicken enchiladas reel (tongue-in-cheek — commenters note it's not a traditional recipe: flour tortillas instead of corn, and a full block of cream cheese used as a wrap layer). Checked 16 of 198 comments (sorted by All Comments) looking for a written recipe from the author; none was posted — comments are mostly reactions/banter. Some commenter tips: fry corn tortillas briefly before rolling to avoid mushiness; some add sautéed onions, green chilies, or cooked Mexican rice to the filling; canned green enchilada sauce recommended by one commenter.
